title: Abner's Eastside Cottage
description:
You'll feel like a native Nashvillian the moment you walk in the door. We took much time and care to create a true sense of home; reclaimed wood headboards, custom kitchen table, and caffeination station. This space was made to be as comfortable as it is versatile-no matter why you came to Music City, the space acclimates to you. Nestled at the edge of quiet Shelby Park but minutes from music, menus, and merchants, this cottage will let you fall in love with the city and its easy Southern charm.

The space
This space was designed to mirror the East Nashville vibe; eclectic, easy-going, creative, and spontaneous. The layout is as perfect for friends ready to explore the city, the couple on a much-needed vacation, the business traveler, or those on an adventure. It has been renovated to give you the greatest comforts of home. Abner's Eastside Cottage has all of the things needed to settle in and stay a while!

Guest access
The cottage is one half of a connected duplex-style dwelling on a quiet no outlet street that backs up to the Shelby Park Greenway (access is a 2 minute drive or 10 minute walk one street over)   The space includes 2 bedrooms, one bathroom, one queen sofa bed in the living room and a large eat in kitchen with a coffee station. There is deck on the back as well as driveway and street parking.

Other things to note
******The Pet fee is $20 per pet for the entire duration of your stay.******

Your pets are welcome at Abner's Eastside Cottage! 
We do require that they be on leash at all times when outside.
Please also use the provided pet beds rather than allowing them on the furniture. We also provide a crate for those times you might leave your pet alone at the cottage. We kindly request that you crate your pets when you are not with them at the cottage. 

Our awesome long term renters  live next door, so parties are NOT allowed.
